#: {{ant|ru|кра́ткий|коро́ткий}}

#: {{syn|ru|высо́кий|t1=tall|долговя́зый|t2=lanky}}

====Usage notes====
The short form should not be conflated with the adjective {{m|ru|дли́нен||too long}}, which has [[lexicalize]]d as a short-form-only adjective in its own right.
